description: Bornes de recharges pour véhicules électriques - Ville de Tarbes is a dataset listed in portail Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by data.gouv.fr. Contexte Dans le but de constituer un répertoire national des Infrastructures de recharge pour véhicules électriques (IRVE), ouvert et accessible à tous, les collectivités locales porteuses d’un projet d’installation d’IRVE doivent, au fur et à mesure de la mise en service des stations, publier sur la plateforme data.gouv.fr les données statiques relatives à la localisation ... Coverage: Hautes-Pyrénées. The portal files it under Routes / Transports. The portal shows 157 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-ha-py-fr-portal.
